decision.title: HTML follow-ups: encoding sniffing, every legacy decoder, the html5lib tests, XHTML (packet 7.10b)
decision.summary: fn:parse-html gains HTML encoding sniffing with a reparse on a meta charset, every legacy decoder of the Encoding Standard, XHTML input parsed as XML, and the vendored html5lib tests.

item.p: Determining the encoding (HTML, 13.2.3.2): octets without a byte order mark or encoding option are prescanned (the first 1024 bytes, the standard's "get an attribute", then "get an XML encoding"), then step 9 (well-formed UTF-8 is UTF-8), then windows-1252; the confidence is then tentative. sxml_html_prepare_input reports the encoding and the confidence.

Changing the encoding while parsing (13.2.3.4): a meta element in "in head" (also reached from "in body") whose charset, or whose http-equiv Content-Type content (HTML, 2.5.3), names another encoding while the confidence is tentative stops tree construction, and the document is parsed again from memory with that encoding, certain: at most two passes. The optional change of decoder on the fly is not done. With fail-on-error and a tentative encoding a pass does not stop at its first parse error, so the errors of a discarded pass never count.

Every encoding (Encoding Standard, 10 to 13): gb18030 (also GBK's decoder), Big5, EUC-JP, ISO-2022-JP, Shift_JIS and EUC-KR decode, one loop each in src/html_encoding.c; "restore to ioQueue" moves the offset back over the bytes just read. The indexes are generated into src/html_encoding_tables.c by tools/generate-html-encodings.py (dense uint16 tables by pointer; Big5's 1,713 plane 2 code points as a sorted pointer list; the 207 gb18030 ranges). No label is FODC0011 any more; an unknown label still is.

XHTML (F&O 4.0, fn:parse-html, a "should"): without a media type the input says what it is. When the document element after the prolog is an unprefixed html with xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" and the decoded input is well-formed XML, sxml_processor_parse_document parses it (the XMLDocument mapping of 17.3.1); otherwise it is HTML. No external DTD is read, so   and the like make it HTML. A prefixed XHTML root is parsed as HTML.

Source locations: not done. The arena tree keeps dm:location only with keeps_locations, and the processor builds every document without it (src/processor.c, XML documents too), so HTML locations would be dropped. When the processor keeps locations, the tokenizer records the line and column of each token's start and the walk of src/html.c puts them on the events, in that one place ().

The html5lib tests are vendored (, 's default): third_party/html5lib-tests/ holds web-platform-tests' html/syntax/parsing/resources (6df7a6ed, BSD) and html5lib-tests' tokenizer/ and encoding/ (c777c408, MIT), pinned in third_party/html5lib-tests.commit; 2.4 MB. tests/html5lib_test.c runs them: tree construction 1,749 of 1,753 (the 4 are selectedcontent, filled by DOM steps of option and select, not by the parser; listed as known failures), 220 fragment and script-on cases left out; tokenizer 7,045 of 7,045 (4 with lone surrogates left out); encoding 82 of 82. Whether there is a parse error agrees in every tokenizer case, and is found in every tree case that lists one (fail-on-error depends on it).
CLI: sxml xpath and sxml xquery have the working directory's file URI as static base URI, so html-doc and unparsed-text of a relative name work (folded into cli-2's 430379b).
Counts (release driver, before and after): fn-parse-html 22/22 (XQ40 and XP40), fn-html-doc 9/10, misc-HtmlTestSuite 1,378/1,379 (XQ40). html-doc-010 and html-test-1281 stay as says.

Sizes (stripped / gzipped, wasm): sxml.wasm 2,134,058 / 743,746 before and after; sxml-full.wasm 6,570,723 / 1,347,198 to 6,755,529 / 1,497,292 (+184,806 / +150,094, nearly all the indexes; budget 7,000,000 / 2,450,000); the CLI module 7,817,964 / 1,593,193 to 8,002,794 / 1,740,606 (budget 9,000,000 / 2,000,000). No budget changes.
